content.text: Now I'll validate the insertion of a general insurance covenant at the end of the base agreement's General section.

ops.text:
16.22 Insurance

MSL shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than U.S. $1,000,000 per occurrence and U.S. $2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than U.S. $2,000,000; (c) where MSL processes, stores or has access to IBM or IBM customer data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than U.S. $5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation and employer's liability insurance as required by applicable law. Such coverage is in addition to the replacement value insurance for consigned Products required under the Statement of Work. MSL shall provide IBM with certificates of insurance upon request.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as MSL occupies IBM premises, holds IBM consigned inventory and accesses IBM systems and customer data, and the Agreement currently requires only replacement-value cover for consigned Products. Our playbook position is CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M with certificates on request; we can work with E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if MSL's existing programme is closer to that level.
input.summary: Insert Section 16.22 requiring MSL to carry commercial general liability, professional liability, cyber and workers' compensation insurance, with certificates on request.
